main_text.p: filios vero non imitari probos parentum. Hippocrat. οἱ πλέσοι τῶν πυρετῶν γίγνονται ἀπὸ χολῆς, plurimæ febrium gignuntur á bile.

Aliquando genere discrepat. Herodot. πίτυς μοιῶν δενδρέων παντῶν ἐκκηπῆσα βλαστὸν ἀπὸ ἕνα μετὴ, ἀλλὰ πρωλέθρος ἐξαπόλλυται, pinus sola omnium arborum excisa germen nullum remittit, sed prorsus interit.
main_text.head: Cap. 5. De adjectivis participationis, dominatus, precii.
main_text.p: Adjectiva item participationis, dominatus, pretii, & similia, genitivo seruiunt. Homerus,
main_text.l: πάσι γὰρ αἰ θεόπολον ἐπιζύνοιον ἀοιδοί
main_text.p: Omnibus enim hominibus in terra degentibus vates

page.notes: Greek passages are only approximately legible on the scan; the Homeric line and the Herodotus line are uncertain. The line "Omnibus enim hominibus in terra degentibus vates" is followed by "gentibus vates" which is a repetition in the printed layout; the heading "Cap. 5." is set in italic and is treated as a level 2 head. Catchword "Hono-" is at the foot of the page as a hyphenated word and is printed as the last line.
